name: Databricks
sku: Databricks platform. Documentation reviewed on the AWS docs site. Other products, such as Genie and agent tooling, are not scored, so derived coverage may understate the platform.

presentation.tagline: Lakehouse platform: Spark compute, warehouse SQL, orchestration and governance under one contract.

cost.note: AWS list rates: Jobs Compute $0.15/DBU, All-Purpose Compute $0.40/DBU, billed on top of the underlying cloud instance cost (~40% more added here, matching Databricks' own rule of thumb). Each point assumes a plausible cluster size and monthly run-hours for a pipeline moving that much data (2-node ~10hr/month at 10GB, up to 64-node ~500hr/month at 1PB) — stated per point, not billed at a flat rate.
